claims.claim: urllib3.ProxyManager is a subclass of urllib3.PoolManager.
urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl includes the inject_into_urllib3() function for integrating PyOpenSSL with urllib3.
claims.citation: Fixed `urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl` to use cryptography APIs when reading a certificate subject and loading encrypted private keys, avoiding `DeprecationWarning` raised by pyOpenSSL 26.3.0+.

claims.claim: UnrewindableBodyError is an exception class defined in the urllib3.exceptions module.
claims.citation: Raised `UnrewindableBodyError` instead of `ValueError` when retrying a request whose body had `tell()` but not `seek()`.

claims.claim: HTTPResponse.drain_conn() discards unread response data by invoking HTTPResponse.stream() with a 64 KiB chunk size.
claims.citation: Fixed `HTTPResponse.drain_conn()` to discard unread response data in 64 KiB chunks (same as the default `amt` when doing `HTTPResponse.stream(...)`).

claims.claim: HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen raises a ValueError whenever it is called with an invalid timeout argument.
claims.citation: Fixed `HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen` raising a misleading `FullPoolError` instead of `ValueError` when called with an invalid `timeout` argument on a pool created with `block=True`.

claims.claim: assert_fingerprint() raises an SSLError whenever a fingerprint contains non-hexadecimal characters.
claims.citation: Fixed `assert_fingerprint()` to raise `SSLError` instead of `binascii.Error` when a fingerprint has a supported length but contains non-hexadecimal characters.
